renderer.backgrounds: Six simple grayscale geometric templates drawn directly by catalog_art_render.py; historical raster designs listed in the prompts are not used or packaged.
renderer.palette: Sixteen paired colour families with three highlight variations, selected independently of shape from the normalized title hash.
renderer.composition: A quiet colour field under the first 58% of a card keeps labels readable. Cards without artwork use one transparent cabinet at 62% of card height, placed toward the right. Real artwork takes precedence.
renderer.geometry: Independent title-hash bytes select rotation up to 30 degrees either way, horizontal offset up to 7% of card width, vertical offset up to 25% of card height, width scale of 82–118%, and height scale of 80–120%. Complete paths are transformed around (82% width, 50% height) before clipping; the caption fade and foreground artwork remain fixed.
